provider: CUHK Department of Physics Enrichment Stream in Theoretical Physics curriculum
note: The official Recommended Course Pattern publishes the fixed Year/Term sequence and alternatives for the Enrichment Stream in Theoretical Physics. The Programme page separately publishes three optional Stream-specific elective structures: Astrophysics and Particle Physics, Artificial Intelligence and Computational Physics, and Quantum Science and Technology. The current Physics Course Information page closes code, title and units for all 36 imported PHYS courses; its downloaded HTML was 313,234 bytes with SHA-256 6bb948c47bd92106ada18dd8ae82731eaf436a25ed0c8ee25caa4b215680f6d2. The current Mathematics Course List closes MATH1010, MATH1018, MATH2010 and MATH2530 at 3 units each. The current CSE Course List closes CSCI3320 at 3 units, while the official QFIN 2025-26 Study Scheme closes STAT3006 at 3 units. The study-pattern HTML was 260,543 bytes with SHA-256 90818463a0adec0955634206b1159d5249237083a8407dcad5284aa006fe4bf7, and the Programme/Stream HTML was 266,522 bytes with SHA-256 70e232639afec2b6378bd611ddf59878db36858473e00bd2b85b5085488261d6. Nine explicitly named options are not imported because the reviewed public pages do not publish a directly verifiable per-course unit value: CHEM1070, CHEM1072, PHYS5061, PHYS5320, PHYS5430, PHYS5510, PHYS5550, PHYS5562 and PHYS5590. The open third Faculty Package choice, variable elective load, overlapping Stream pools, alternative PHYS3031/PHYS4031 path and unimported options prevent a closed graduation rule. This 42-course evidence-backed subset is therefore browse-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and no graduation completion percentage. PHYS4450 uses the current Course Information title Optical Physics rather than the shorter Optics wording on the Stream page.
